=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2420-2433 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: validate-scripts depends on source but lacks explicit if: needs.source.result == 'success' gating.
  WHY: Both reviewers call out the missing explicit gate; GitHub Actions will still auto-skip the job on a failed need, so this is a readability/hardening gap rather than a runtime failure.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:~69 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: resolve-version uses git tag --list 'v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*' --sort=-v:refname without --merged HEAD filtering, which can pick a newer tag from main when releasing from stable.
  WHY: The next stable patch can be computed from the wrong tag if main is ahead of stable.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:~259 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: STATE=$(_gh_retry gh api ... 2>/dev/null || echo "pending") treats API failure as pending, allowing release to proceed without verified CI status.
  WHY: Sustained GitHub API errors can let the release gate pass without confirmed CI health.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:76-78, 93-100 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: On merge conflict, the workflow aborts the merge and pushes from refs/remotes/origin/stable, discarding the attempted merge result and conflict context.
  WHY: The fallback PR loses merge attempt information that would help reviewers resolve conflicts.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
